pages.title: Theoretical Notes III
pages.text: The last theoretical volume: category theory, the multiverse, string coupling, metallic hydrogen, supernovae and gravitational waves. By the final page I was drawing commutative diagrams in the margins of an astrophysics paper and not noticing.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)I closed the theoretical record with the pieces that tied structure to cosmos: a category lattice, a multiverse shard and a string coupling crystal beside a supernova remnant and a gravitational wave crystal. The Femtoscale line made them read as one argument.
